findings.summary: PostedMessage.route is typed RouteKind, so the OpenAPI document and schema.ts advertise 'refuse' on the 202 body. No path returns it: every REFUSE branch of ConversationFlow.post_message either raises CONFLICT or returns START through _unlinked. Typing it Literal[RouteKind.START, RouteKind.ANSWER] would make the client type Task 4e.3 consumes honest. The report already notes this deviation.

The route authorization test walks only /v1/ APIRoutes. The health probes are out of scope in PR-27's row, but nothing asserts that list, so a later unguarded APIRoute outside /v1 would pass silently. One assertion that the non-/v1 APIRoute paths are exactly {/health/live, /health/ready} would make the row's out-of-scope list a checked fact (PR-06, PR-27). The test matches the brief's PL-9 scope as written, so this is style.

_refused checks the envelope's key set {code, message, correlation_id} but not that correlation_id is non-empty, so a null correlation id would still pass test_conversation_errors_use_the_error_envelope.
